privacidad.title: Personal data processing
privacidad.intro: This page explains what data we ask for when submitting a quote request and how we handle it, under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012.
privacidad.whatBody: Name, email, phone and, if you want to leave them, additional comments. No other personal data is stored in the system.
privacidad.whyBody: To respond to your quote request and coordinate your cap's production. We don't use it for advertising or share it with third parties.
privacidad.retentionBody: 12 months from when the request reaches a final status (quoted-closed or rejected). After that, the personal data is deleted automatically; the design and the request's history are kept because they aren't personal data.
privacidad.anonymizationBody: Write to us with your request's code and ask for anonymization. The team applies it from the panel; the action can't be undone.
